name: creche-segura
description: Controle de entrada e saída de crianças na creche com carteirinha NFC/QR, alertas para os responsáveis e painel para a administração.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev -w shared" "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
